intro: G Pulla Reddy College of Pharmacy and MLR Institute of Pharmacy both sit in Hyderabad, and this page compares their recorded B.Pharm fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in 2026.

G Pulla Reddy College of Pharmacy vs MLR Institute of Pharmacy is not a single winner. Both are recorded as private institutes. Pick the campus that matches the programme you want, the fee you can pay, and the admission test you will take.

sections.heading: G Pulla Reddy College of Pharmacy vs MLR Institute of Pharmacy for B.Pharm: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose G Pulla Reddy College of Pharmacy if its B.Pharm programme, location and recorded outcomes match the kind of work or further study you want.
Choose MLR Institute of Pharmacy if its course mix, city or recorded fee level is the better fit, rather than looking for one campus that wins on every count.
G Pulla Reddy College of Pharmacy lists Bachelor of Pharmacy General. MLR Institute of Pharmacy lists Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.).

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip application, hostel-only or short-course rows so a registration fee is not treated as tuition.

Our records list ₹80,000 a year as tuition fees for G Pulla Reddy College of Pharmacy's Bachelor of Pharmacy General. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.
Our records do not hold a quotable B.Pharm programme fee for MLR Institute of Pharmacy on this page. Confirm the current official fee notice before you budget.
If fees are your only filter, confirm the current official circular for the exact programme and batch you will join, because year figures and older rows can understate the real cost.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: G Pulla Reddy College of Pharmacy's recorded admission tests on this page include TS EAPCET.
Our records do not list a specific entrance exam for MLR Institute of Pharmacy on this B.Pharm page. Use the current official admission note for eligibility and tests.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Hyderabad, Telangana. The choice is less about moving city and more about the programme, fees and admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read the official hostel and location notes, before you accept an offer.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: There is no universal winner in G Pulla Reddy College of Pharmacy vs MLR Institute of Pharmacy for B.Pharm. Use the programme list, the official fee notice and the admission test to decide.
If one side is missing a quotable fee or a recent official placement year, do not fill the gap with a guess from another course or an older batch.
